doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: How he got the Lester Young job and Town Hall with Billie Holiday
summary: Thornton, who knew Haynes through Miles and Bird, told manager Charlie Carpenter; he started at the Savoy and played Town Hall.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Billie Holiday as the musicians knew her

blocks.x: Are you married by this time?
Was I married at this time?
No. We’re talking about ’47. Let’s talk about how you hooked up. So Dense introduces you? How did he facilitate this?

No. He knew about me, because I think we probably had played gigs or something together, because he used to be around Miles. He was on that record with Bird and Miles anyhow. He played piano on those records.

Like I say, once certain people in the music – it was almost like a family, so different people knew me. He told the manager, who was Charlie Carpenter. I started with them at the Savoy in that same week.

I think that’s who either come by to get me or something. I started with them right at the Savoy. In that same week they had to play at Town Hall one night and accompany Billie Holiday. So I was really into that.
